sources.protocol_note: Use all saved RRF union candidates, score 27 pairs once (5 batches). No labels provided to model. No formal inference during preparation.

protocol.model_inputs: query and original document text only; no labels, titles or IDs
protocol.candidate_pool: entire saved RRF-ranked union; no extra retrieval or pre-rerank top-5 cutoff
protocol.ties: stable sort preserves saved RRF candidate order
protocol.score: raw sequence classification logit, not probability
